lines.zh: 我贴着珊瑚游，尾柄的刀片竖着。
lines.en: I swim past the coral with my tail blade raised.

lines.zh: 三条七条，我们排成一片会动的颜色。
lines.en: Three, seven of us, one moving patch of color.

lines.zh: 暖水推着我，我顺着它拐了个弯。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me and I bend along with it.

lines.zh: 我啃过这丛藻，留下一道浅痕。
lines.en: I graze this algae patch and leave a pale scar.

lines.zh: 我们同向摆尾，像有人喊了节拍。
lines.en: We flick our tails together, as if keeping a beat.

lines.zh: 我游得急，尾刺刮过珊瑚枝。
lines.en: I swim fast and my spine scrapes a coral branch.

lines.zh: 前面的同伴一停，我差点撞上去。
lines.en: The one ahead stops and I nearly crash into it.

lines.zh: 我在礁石缝里侧过身，刚好挤过去。
lines.en: I turn sideways and just slip through the reef gap.

lines.zh: 阳光打进水里，我的鳞片亮了一下。
lines.en: Sunlight enters the water and my scales flash once.

lines.zh: 我绕着这片珊瑚转第三圈了。
lines.en: I have circled this coral head three times now.

lines.zh: 队伍散开又合上，我夹在中间。
lines.en: The school parts and closes; I am in the middle.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙底游，避开上面的影子。
lines.en: I skim the sand to stay under that shadow.

lines.zh: 暖流把我带离礁盘，我又拐回来。
lines.en: The current carries me off the reef; I turn back.

lines.zh: 我尾后那片蓝，就是我的整片海。
lines.en: That blue behind my tail is my whole ocean.

lines.zh: 我抢在同伴前面，先咬一口藻。
lines.en: I get ahead of the group and take the first bite of algae.

lines.zh: 我的尾柄擦过珊瑚，留了道白。
lines.en: My tail stock grazes the coral and leaves a white mark.

lines.zh: 水流一变，我们整群掉了个头。
lines.en: The current shifts and the whole school turns around.

lines.zh: 我钻进石缝又出来，颜色更亮。
lines.en: I duck into a crack and come out brighter.

lines.zh: 我悬在珊瑚上方，尾鳍轻轻打水。
lines.en: I hover over the coral, tail fanning softly.

lines.zh: 水从鳃边过，我不太想动。
lines.en: Water passes my gills; I do not care to move.

lines.zh: 这一小片暖水，刚好够我们七条。
lines.en: This patch of warm water fits all seven of us.

lines.zh: 我盯着珊瑚虫张开又合上。
lines.en: I watch the polyps open and close.

lines.zh: 骨头磨成粉的味道，从很远飘来。
lines.en: The smell of ground bone drifts from far away.

lines.zh: 我贴着一块石头，装作石头的一部分。
lines.en: I press to a rock and pretend to be part of it.

lines.zh: 潮水停了，整片礁盘都安静下来。
lines.en: The tide stills and the whole reef goes quiet.

lines.zh: 我把尾刺收好，今天不打算扎谁。
lines.en: I keep my spine sheathed; no stabbing today.

lines.zh: 同伴在左边，我不用回头也知道。
lines.en: My schoolmate is on my left; I know without looking.

lines.zh: 这片海太亮，我眯起不存在的眼皮。
lines.en: The sea is too bright; I squint lids I do not have.

lines.zh: 我一遍遍数自己的呼吸，越数越慢。
lines.en: I count each breath again and again, slower each time.

lines.zh: 沙上落了一小撮骨粉，我绕开它。
lines.en: A pinch of bone meal lies on the sand; I swim around it.

lines.zh: 我和同伴隔着一尾，谁也没出声。
lines.en: I keep one tail-length from the school; nobody speaks.

lines.zh: 晒够了，我就在这片暖水里停着。
lines.en: Having soaked enough sun, I simply stay in this warmth.

lines.zh: 你把脸贴到水面上，我也抬眼看你。
lines.en: You press your face to the water; I look up too.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住珊瑚，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: Your shadow covers the coral and I do not like it.

lines.zh: 你手里那个空桶，我认得。
lines.en: That empty bucket in your hand, I know it.

lines.zh: 你比礁鲨大，可你不动，我就看着。
lines.en: You are bigger than a reef shark, but still, so I watch.

lines.zh: 我在你眼里是一小片彩色，对吧。
lines.en: In your eyes I am a small patch of color, right?

lines.zh: 你数得清我们七条，还是只数到五？
lines.en: Can you count all seven of us, or only five?

lines.zh: 你靠近一步，我就退半尾。
lines.en: You come one step closer; I retreat half a tail.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸在水面响，我听得见。
lines.en: Your breathing sounds on the surface; I hear it.

lines.zh: 你想抓我，得先追得上这片暖水。
lines.en: To catch me you must first outswim this warm water.

lines.zh: 我看你很久了，你却以为我在发呆。
lines.en: I have watched you long; you think I am dreaming.

lines.zh: 我翻了个身，白肚皮朝上又翻回来。
lines.en: I flip over, belly up, then right myself.

lines.zh: 鳞掉了几片，水里都是碎彩。
lines.en: Scales come off and the water fills with broken color.

lines.zh: 我疼得尾刺全立起来了。
lines.en: Pain snaps my tail spine fully upright.

lines.zh: 我沉了一下，又挣扎着浮起。
lines.en: I sink a little, then struggle back up.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我该走了。
lines.en: Blood spreads through the water; I should go.

lines.zh: 我的肉大概会进你的桶里。
lines.en: My flesh will likely end up in your bucket.

lines.zh: 别打了，我的骨头只够磨一点粉。
lines.en: Stop; my bones are only good for a little meal.

lines.zh: 我撞在珊瑚上，伤口又裂开。
lines.en: I hit the coral and the wound opens again.

lines.zh: 整群都散了，只剩我一个在转。
lines.en: The school scatters; only I spin alone.

lines.zh: 我还在喘，鳃一下一下地开合。
lines.en: I am still gasping, gills opening and closing.

lines.zh: 那丛嫩藻晃了晃，我尾巴先动了。
lines.en: That tender algae sways and my tail moves first.

lines.zh: 你撒下的碎藻落在沙上，我看见了。
lines.en: The algae bits you scatter land on the sand; I see them.

lines.zh: 我闻到藻味，往前挪了一小截。
lines.en: I smell the algae and drift forward a little.

lines.zh: 你晃着水桶，我偏偏不进去。
lines.en: You shake the bucket; I refuse to go in.

lines.zh: 再近一点，再近一点，我就咬一口。
lines.en: Closer, just a little closer, and I will take a bite.

lines.zh: 我盯着那片绿，忘了后面还有你。
lines.en: I stare at the green and forget you are behind it.

lines.zh: 这味道像我家礁盘上的老藻。
lines.en: This tastes like the old algae of my home reef.

lines.zh: 我兜了一圈，又漂回你身边。
lines.en: I drift a full circle and float back to your side.

lines.zh: 你手里那点吃食，值一条尾巴吗？
lines.en: Is that morsel worth one tail of mine?

lines.zh: 我试探着咬了一下，又立刻退开。
lines.en: I test one bite, then retreat at once.

lines.zh: 你顶过来，我横着翻了个身。
lines.en: You shove and I tip over sideways.

lines.zh: 我尾柄的刀片擦到你，你该疼了。
lines.en: My tail blade grazes you; that should sting.

lines.zh: 让一让，这条缝只够一条鱼过。
lines.en: Move aside; this gap fits only one fish.

lines.zh: 你的靴子搅起沙，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: Your boot stirs the sand and I see nothing.

lines.zh: 我被挤到珊瑚上，鳞片刮掉一片。
lines.en: I am shoved onto coral and lose a scale.

lines.zh: 别用桶口顶我，那不算抓。
lines.en: Do not nudge me with the bucket rim; that is not catching.

lines.zh: 我们七条一起躲，你只碰到最后一条。
lines.en: All seven dodge; you only touch the last one.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气透过水，烫了一下。
lines.en: Your body heat reaches through the water and stings.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾弹开，尾刺差点立起来。
lines.en: I flick away, my spine almost snapping upright.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，可我的队形散了。
lines.en: Not a hard hit, but my school's shape breaks.

lines.zh: 我退到珊瑚后面，从另一边看你。
lines.en: I retreat behind the coral and watch from the other side.

lines.zh: 这条水道太窄，我们都卡住了。
lines.en: This channel is too narrow; we are both stuck.

lines.zh: 暖水里我们的颜色会亮一层。
lines.en: In warm water our colors brighten by one shade.

lines.zh: 我绕着同伴转圈，尾鳍扫起细沙。
lines.en: I circle my partner, tail fanning up fine sand.

lines.zh: 两条影子在礁石上叠成一团。
lines.en: Two shadows fold into one on the reef rock.

lines.zh: 春天来了，暖流把我们都叫醒。
lines.en: Spring comes; the warm current wakes us all.

lines.zh: 我挑那个尾刺最直的同伴。
lines.en: I choose the one whose tail spine is straightest.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，只是一起摆尾。
lines.en: We say nothing and only flick our tails together.

lines.zh: 卵落在珊瑚缝里，谁也看不见。
lines.en: The eggs settle in a coral crack where none can see.

lines.zh: 七条里，我只跟这一条并排游。
lines.en: Of the seven, I swim beside only this one.

lines.zh: 等这一季过去，我们会分群。
lines.en: When the season ends, our school will split.

lines.zh: 我把最好的藻让给它，它懂了。
lines.en: I give it the best algae, and it understands.

lines.zh: 我只有鳍，捡不起你掉的东西。
lines.en: I have only fins; I cannot pick up what you drop.

lines.zh: 那块铁沉到沙里，我绕着它游。
lines.en: The iron sinks into the sand; I circle it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴碰了碰，它比珊瑚还硬。
lines.en: I nudge it with my mouth; it is harder than coral.

lines.zh: 你掉了东西，水替你收着。
lines.en: You dropped something; the water keeps it for you.

lines.zh: 我兜了一圈，什么也没叼起来。
lines.en: I make a full round and carry nothing.

lines.zh: 尾刺能划开鳞，却夹不住一粒沙。
lines.en: My spine can cut scales but cannot hold a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 那东西反光，晃得我掉头就走。
lines.en: The thing glints and I turn away from it.

lines.zh: 我从掉落物上面游过，没停。
lines.en: I swim over the dropped item without stopping.

lines.zh: 沉下去吧，沉到底就归沙了。
lines.en: Sink then; at the bottom it belongs to the sand.

lines.zh: 我试着顶了一下，它纹丝不动。
lines.en: I try pushing it; it does not shift at all.

lines.zh: 我闻到血味，先看的是礁石后面。
lines.en: I smell blood and look behind the reef first.

lines.zh: 你的影子一变，我整群都转过来。
lines.en: Your shadow shifts and the whole school turns.

lines.zh: 有个东西在动，我要盯住它。
lines.en: Something is moving; I will keep my eye on it.

lines.zh: 我不打谁，但我得知道谁在靠近。
lines.en: I fight no one, but I must know who nears.

lines.zh: 剑鱼来了，我们七条一起沉下去。
lines.en: A swordfish comes; all seven of us sink.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: When you look at me, your eyes do not blink.

lines.zh: 我把尾刺对准那个方向，只是防着。
lines.en: I aim my spine that way, only in defense.

lines.zh: 水面有动静，我退到珊瑚底下。
lines.en: Something stirs at the surface; I slip under the coral.

lines.zh: 我记住你的位置了，别靠太近。
lines.en: I have your position; do not come too close.

lines.zh: 那条大鱼游过来，我们散成一片。
lines.en: That big fish approaches and we scatter wide.

lines.zh: 我围着你转，等你先动。
lines.en: I circle you, waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我的尾刺一直朝着你，没放下。
lines.en: My tail spine stays pointed at you, never lowered.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我退一尾，就这样。
lines.en: You step once, I back one tail-length. That is all.

lines.zh: 我不看你的眼睛，只看你的十根手指。
lines.en: I skip your eyes and study your ten fingers instead.

lines.zh: 我们七条分开了，你追不到全部。
lines.en: The seven of us have split; you cannot chase us all.

lines.zh: 你要是伸手，我就往珊瑚缝里钻。
lines.en: If you reach out, I will dive into the coral crack.

lines.zh: 我不咬人，但尾刺不长眼。
lines.en: I do not bite, but my spine does not look where it cuts.

lines.zh: 你在水里太笨重了，我放心了。
lines.en: You are clumsy in the water; that reassures me.

lines.zh: 这个距离，我还能跑。
lines.en: At this distance I can still get away.

lines.zh: 我侧着身，把刀片藏在尾巴后。
lines.en: I turn sideways and hide the blade behind my tail.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，刀片在你手背划一道。
lines.en: I whip my tail and the blade cuts your hand.

lines.zh: 我不咬，我只让你松手。
lines.en: I do not bite; I only make you let go.

lines.zh: 别捏我，刺尾鱼的名字不是白叫的。
lines.en: Do not squeeze me; my name is not spine-tail for nothing.

lines.zh: 这一下是警告，下一次更深。
lines.en: This one is a warning; the next goes deeper.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下就跑，尾刺朝后。
lines.en: I bump you and flee, spine pointed backward.

lines.zh: 你抓得太紧，我只好扎你。
lines.en: You hold too tight, so I have to sting you.

lines.zh: 我的刀片很小，划开皮足够了。
lines.en: My blade is small; it is enough to open skin.

lines.zh: 我挣了一下，你的指缝冒出血珠。
lines.en: I jerk free and a bead of blood rises at your fingers.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，可我能让你疼。
lines.en: I cannot beat you, but I can make you hurt.

lines.zh: 放手，我就游开，谁也不欠谁。
lines.en: Let go and I swim off; then neither owes the other.

lines.zh: 暖水海洋，礁盘边上，我出生了。
lines.en: Warm ocean, at the reef's edge, I am born.

lines.zh: 我们三条一起落进这片珊瑚。
lines.en: Three of us drop into this coral together.

lines.zh: 水是温的，光也是，我张开鳍。
lines.en: The water is warm, the light too; I open my fins.

lines.zh: 第一口藻是咸的，我记住了。
lines.en: The first mouthful of algae is salty; I remember it.

lines.zh: 礁盘很大，我只有一根手指长。
lines.en: The reef is huge and I am one finger long.

lines.zh: 我和同窝的伙伴挤在一道缝里。
lines.en: I huddle in one crack with my clutchmates.

lines.zh: 潮水把我推动，我第一次游动。
lines.en: The tide nudges me; I swim for the first time.

lines.zh: 我身上已经有一小片彩了。
lines.en: Already I carry a small patch of color.

lines.zh: 头顶的鲨鱼影子，我学会了躲。
lines.en: I learn to dodge the shark shadow overhead.

lines.zh: 这是我的暖水，我数过了，七条。
lines.en: This is my warm water; I counted, seven of us.

lines.zh: 火在水面烧，我躲到最深的缝里。
lines.en: Fire burns on the surface; I hide in the deepest crack.

lines.zh: 我被甩出水面，在甲板上弹了两下。
lines.en: I am flung out of water and bounce twice on the deck.

lines.zh: 我本来是鱼，离了水才叫窒息。
lines.en: I am a fish; it is leaving water that drowns me.

lines.zh: 冲击把整块珊瑚炸开，我被掀翻。
lines.en: The blast shatters the coral and flips me over.

lines.zh: 箭射进水里偏了，擦掉我一排鳞。
lines.en: The arrow enters the water off course and shaves a row of scales.

lines.zh: 魔法让水变冷，我的鳍僵住了。
lines.en: Magic chills the water and my fins go stiff.

lines.zh: 藻都被吃光了，我瘦得能看见骨架。
lines.en: The algae is gone and my ribs show through.

lines.zh: 雷打进海里，我全身麻了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sea and my whole body goes numb.

lines.zh: 这里没有水，也没有颜色。
lines.en: Here there is no water and no color.
